fluff.overview: The Free Worlds League Military has long fielded some of the largest infantry formations in the Inner Sphere, with regiments numbering nearly 1,800 soldiers compared to roughly 750 in the Combine and just over 1,000 in the Federated Suns. Jump infantry in League service exploit vertical mobility to compensate for the FWLM's sometimes fragmented command structure, seizing terrain that wheeled or tracked forces cannot reach. Their ability to operate across broken ground and urban environments makes them valuable in the border provinces where coalition territory changes hands frequently. Equipped with laser rifles that offer superior range and armor penetration compared to ballistic weapons, these platoons field one of the most effective personal arms available to conventional infantry, though the weapons are significantly more expensive and require soldiers to carry additional power packs. Trained in anti-BattleMech tactics, these platoons specialize in coordinated attacks against the legs, joints, and sensor clusters of enemy BattleMechs, exploiting the vulnerabilities that heavy machines present to disciplined close-quarters infantry.
